67:1: How exalted is He in whose hand is the dominion, and He is capable of all things.
67:2: He Who created death and life to test which of you is best in deed. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Much-Forgiving.
67:3: He Who created seven heavens layer upon layer. You see no inconsistency in the creation of ar-Rahman. Turn your gaze and look: do you see any flaw?
67:4: Then turn your gaze back twice. Your gaze will return to you humbled and weary.
67:5: And by oath, We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps, and We made them missiles for the devils, and We prepared for them the punishment of the blazing fire.
67:6: And for those who disbelieve in their Rabb, there is the punishment of Hell, and what an evil destination it is!
67:7: When they are thrown into it, they hear its roaring as it boils up.
67:8: It almost bursts with rage. Whenever a group is thrown into it, its keepers ask them: Did a warner not come to you?
67:9: They said: Yes, a warner came to us, but we denied and said: Allah has not sent down anything. You are only in great misguidance.
67:10: And they said: If we had listened or reasoned, we would not be among the companions of the blazing fire.
67:11: Thus they confessed their sins; so away with the companions of the blazing fire!
67:12: Indeed, for those who fear their Rabb in the unseen, there is forgiveness and a great reward.
67:13: Whether you conceal your speech or declare it, indeed He is Knower of that which is in the breasts.
67:14: Does He Who created not know? And He is al-Latif, the All-Aware.
67:15: He Who made the earth docile for you. So walk in its paths and eat of His provision. And to Him is the resurrection.
67:16: Have you become secure from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you, and behold, it shakes?
67:17: Or have you become secure from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not send upon you a stone-bearing storm? Then you will know how My warning is.
67:18: And by oath, those before them also denied. Then how was My rejection?
67:19: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding them? None holds them except ar-Rahman. Indeed, He is the All-Seer of all things.
67:20: Or who is this that could be an army for you to help you besides ar-Rahman? The disbelievers are only in delusion.
67:21: Or who is it that will provide for you if He withholds His provision? Rather, they have persisted in defiance and aversion.
67:22: Is he who crawls upon his face more guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path?
67:23: Say: It is He Who created you and made for you hearing, sights, and hearts. How little you give thanks!
67:24: Say: It is He Who multiplied you in the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
67:25: And they say: When is this promise, if you are truthful?
67:26: Say: "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."
67:27: When they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will turn black, and it will be said: "This is what you used to call for."
67:28: Say: Have you seen, if Allah should destroy me and those with me, or have mercy upon us, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?
67:29: Say: He is ar-Rahman. We have believed in Him, and in Him we have put our trust. Soon you will know who is in clear misguidance.
67:30: Say: "Have you seen, if your water should become sunken into the ground, who could bring you flowing spring water?"
